scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const f of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) fs.existsSync(f) && fs.rmSync(f,{force:true}); if (!process.env.npm_config_user_agent || !process.env.npm_config_user_agent.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.dev:frontend: cross-env PORT=5000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --dir artifacts/campusmind-ai dev
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend "cross-env PORT=8080 pnpm --dir artifacts/api-server dev" "cross-env PORT=5000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --dir artifacts/campusmind-ai dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
